crossRefs.note: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
If the ax is blunt, and one doesn’t sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but skill brings success.
Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

translations.web: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
translations.bsb: Discretion will watch over you, and understanding will guard you,
translations.kjv: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep
translations.asv: Discretion shall watch over thee; Understanding shall keep thee:
